title: Two-sided marketplace website
summary: A platform site where buyers and sellers must find each other and transact: searchable listings, rich listing detail, a trust layer, and a parallel funnel for the scarce supply side.
defaults: Search or browse the listings in one step from the landing view
Model buyer and seller as distinct roles with separate paths
Show trust signals (ratings, reviews, profiles) next to every offer
risks: Single undifferentiated user role instead of the two sides
No search-plus-filter pattern for discovering listings
Trust layer (reviews, ratings) missing from offers
verification: Search or filter listings and open a listing detail view
Complete a buyer-side booking or purchase path
Join or publish as the seller side and see the listing appear
site_goals: Acquire and transact both sides of the market
Acquire the scarce supply side (sellers, hosts, providers)
Build trust between strangers with ratings, reviews, and profiles
